title: Webhooks
intro: Floorbit sends the events you pick to other tools as they happen, as a signed JSON POST: a ticket system, a chat bot, a scoreboard. Payloads never carry nicks, IPs or MACs.
name: Name
rotateQuestion: Make a new signing secret? The receiver rejects deliveries until it has the new one.
removeQuestion: Remove "{{name}}"? It stops getting events right away.
secretHelp: Give this to the receiver to check the Floorbit-Signature header. Copy it now: it isn't shown again.
docs: How to check the signature, and what each event sends: docs/api.md#webhooks.
